text:
anya: hi all, first day! quick cloud question: i need GCP access for project `redwood-apac-playground` (BigQuery read + Cloud SQL client) and want it linked to the APAC billing account. who handles the billing link and IAM?
ravi-peopleops: welcome anya! please submit the onboarding cloud form and add your manager as approver so we can start the request: https://redwood.internal/onboard-cloud
mike-infra: once people-ops confirms, we'll add `roles/bigquery.dataViewer` and `roles/cloudsql.client`. paste the exact project id and your redwood email. we prefer to grant `iam.serviceAccountUser` only on specific service accounts rather than project-wide.
anya: project id: `redwood-apac-playground-7`, email anya@redwood.com. also need read-only S3 access in ap-southeast-1 for a demo bucket.
omar-billing: billing is `redwood-apac-billing`. I can link after people-ops approval. ping me once the form is approved and i'll attach the project.
devex-bot: protip: infra uses this gcloud snippet in PRs:
``gcloud projects add-iam-policy-binding redwood-apac-playground-7 --member=user:anya@redwood.com --role=roles/bigquery.dataViewer```
ravi-peopleops: saw the form + manager approval. moving to infra.
mike-infra: creating the infra ticket now (ND-5882). will handle IAM PR and ask omar for billing link when ready.
anya: thanks everyone! :tada:
